blocks.text: would — tasavvurdagi dunyo va o'tmishdagi will

**would** (qisqa shakli **'d**, inkori **wouldn't**) bilan qizil kitobda tanishgansiz: **I'd like** ... (→ qizil kitob, 34-dars) va If I had ..., I **would** ... (→ qizil kitob, 100-dars). Aslida would ning bir nechta vazifasi bor: tasavvurdagi holat, amalga oshmagan o'tmish (**would have done**), **will** ning o'tmishdagi shakli, «ko'nmadi» ma'nosidagi **wouldn't** va o'tmishdagi takroriy odat. Qiziq tomoni: o'zbekchadagi «**-ardi**» ham ikki ma'noli — «borardim» (tasavvur) va «yozda qishloqqa borardik» (odat). Inglizchada ham ikkalasi uchun **would**.

rows: It **would** be nice to live by the sea.
I **would have helped**, but I was ill.
We **would** swim in the river every day.

blocks.text: **would** + fe'l — haqiqatda yo'q, faqat **tasavvur qilingan** holat. If-qism ko'pincha aytilmaydi, lekin nazarda tutiladi: I **wouldn't** do that (= agar men sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam); A holiday **would** be great (= agar imkonim bo'lsa). O'zbekchada «**-ardi(m)**», «**-ar edi**». Shu sababli would bilan gaplar ko'pincha orzu, xushmuomala fikr yoki ehtiyotkor maslahat kabi eshitiladi.

items.text: A bigger flat **would** make our lives much easier.
I **wouldn't** trust that website — the prices look too good to be true.
items.translation: Men o'sha saytga **ishonmasdim** — narxlari haddan tashqari arzon ko'rinyapti.

blocks.text: **will** — real kelajak: bu narsa haqiqatda bo'lishini kutyapmiz. **would** — tasavvur: sharoit yo'q, harakat bo'lmaydi yoki ehtimoli juda kam. I**'ll** help you on Saturday — Shanba kuni **yordam beraman** (va beraman). I**'d** help you, but I'm busy — **Yordam berardim**, lekin bandman (demak, bermayman). Xuddi shu farq real va xayoliy shart orasida ham bor (→ 38-dars).

items.text: We**'ll** visit you in Fergana next month — we've already bought the tickets.
items.translation: Kelasi oy Farg'onaga sizlarnikiga **boramiz** — chiptalarni allaqachon oldik.

items.text: We**'d** visit you more often, but the journey is so long.
items.translation: Sizlarnikiga tez-tez **borardik**, lekin yo'l juda uzoq.

blocks.text: would have done — amalga oshmagan o'tmish

**would have** + V3 — o'tmishda **bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin bo'lmadi**. Ko'pincha **but**, **otherwise** (aks holda) yoki **without** bilan: I **would have called** you, but my phone was dead — Qo'ng'iroq **qilgan bo'lardim**, lekin telefonim o'chib qolgan edi. O'zbekchada «**-gan bo'lardi(m)**». Og'zaki nutqda: I**'d have called**. If-qismli to'liq qolip (If I had known, I would have ...) — 40-darsda (→ 40-dars).

items.text: Sarah **would have come** to the meeting, but her train was cancelled.
items.translation: Sara yig'ilishga **kelgan bo'lardi**, lekin poyezdi bekor qilindi.

items.text: Without your map, we **wouldn't have found** the waterfall.

blocks.text: O'tmishdan turib kelajak haqida gapirganda **will** → **would** ga aylanadi: «I'll call you» → She said she **would** call me (→ 47-dars). **knew**, **thought**, **hoped**, **was sure** dan keyin ham shunday. **wouldn't** esa ko'pincha «**istamadi, ko'nmadi**» degani: She **wouldn't** tell me — Menga **aytishni istamadi**. Jonsiz narsalar uchun ham: The door **wouldn't** open — Eshik **ochilmadi** (qancha urinmaylik).

items.text: I knew the exam **would** be difficult, so I started revising early.
items.translation: Imtihon qiyin **bo'lishini** bilardim, shuning uchun erta takrorlashni boshladim.

items.text: My little brother **wouldn't** eat his vegetables, however hard Mum tried.
items.translation: Oyim qanchalik urinmasin, ukam sabzavotlarini **yeyishni istamadi**.

blocks.text: **would** + fe'l o'tmishda **muntazam takrorlangan harakatni** ham bildiradi — **used to** ga yaqin (→ 18-dars). Odatda avval vaqt ko'rsatiladi (When I was a child..., Every summer...), keyin would bilan davom ettiriladi. Muhim cheklov: would faqat **harakatlar** uchun, **holatlar** (have, be, live, know) uchun emas: I **used to have** a bike (✓), «I would have a bike» (✗ — bu boshqa ma'no). O'zbekchada «**-ardik**»: «Yozda qishloqqa **borardik**».

items.text: Every evening my grandfather **would** listen to the radio news in the garden.
items.translation: Har kuni kechqurun bobom bog'da radio yangiliklarini **tinglardi**.

items.text: We **used to** live near the bazaar, and Mum **would** send me there for bread.
items.translation: Biz bozor yaqinida **yashardik**, oyim meni u yerga nonga **yuborardi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I would went» → I **would go** yoki I **would have gone** (would dan keyin doim asosiy shakl yoki have + V3); «If I would know, I would tell you» → If I **knew**, I would tell you (if-qismda would yo'q, → 38–39-darslar); «When I was young, I would have a dog» → I **used to have** a dog (holat uchun would emas); «She said she will call» o'tmishdagi hikoyada → She said she **would** call.

would ni tarjima qilishda o'zbekcha «**-ardi**» ga suyaning: «borardim» — tasavvur (I'd go), «borardik» hikoyada — odat (we would go), «borgan bo'lardim» — amalga oshmagan o'tmish (I would have gone). Qaysi ma'no ekanini kontekst — xuddi o'zbek tilidagidek — aniqlab beradi.

rows: I**'d** love a cup of tea.

examples.title: Imagining: **would** / **'d**
examples.description: would + fe'l — haqiqatda yo'q, tasavvur qilingan holat. If-qism ko'pincha aytilmaydi, lekin nazarda tutiladi. O'zbekchada «-ardi».

sentences.text: **It would be** lovely to live by the sea, but all our family is in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Dengiz bo'yida yashash **ajoyib bo'lardi**, lekin butun oilamiz Toshkentda.

sentences.text: I**'d love** to work abroad for a year, just to see what it's like.
sentences.translation: Bir yil chet elda **ishlashni juda xohlardim**, faqat qanday bo'lishini ko'rish uchun.

sentences.text: Sarah **would** never do anything to hurt her friends.
sentences.translation: Sara hech qachon do'stlarini xafa qiladigan ish **qilmasdi**.

sentences.text: A four-day working week **would** make most people happier and more productive.
sentences.translation: To'rt kunlik ish haftasi ko'pchilikni baxtliroq va samaraliroq **qilardi**.

sentences.text: Without the internet, my job **would** be almost impossible.
sentences.translation: Internetsiz ishim deyarli imkonsiz **bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: **Would** you ever go skydiving? — Never! I**'d be** far too scared.
sentences.translation: Hech parashyutdan **sakrarmidingiz**? — Hech qachon! Juda **qo'rqib ketardim**.

sentences.text: Imagine winning a million pounds — what **would** you do first?
sentences.translation: Million funt yutib olganingizni tasavvur qiling — birinchi navbatda nima **qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: A trip to Khiva **wouldn't** cost much if we took the night train.
sentences.translation: Tungi poyezdga chiqsak, Xivaga sayohat unchalik qimmatga **tushmasdi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **would** be proud of you if he could see you now.
sentences.translation: Bobom seni hozir ko'rganida, sen bilan **faxrlanardi**.

sentences.text: In your position, I **wouldn't** sign anything until a lawyer had read the contract.
sentences.translation: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, advokat shartnomani o'qib chiqmaguncha hech narsaga **imzo chekmasdim**.

examples.title: **will** or **would**? Real plans and imagined ones
examples.description: will — real kelajak, haqiqatda bo'ladi; would — tasavvur, sharoit yo'q. Gaplar juft-juft: avval will, keyin would.

sentences.text: I**'ll** help you with the move on Saturday — I'm free all day.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni ko'chishingizga **yordam beraman** — kun bo'yi bo'shman.

sentences.text: I**'d** help you with the move, but I'm working all weekend.
sentences.translation: Ko'chishingizga **yordam berardim**, lekin butun dam olish kunlari ishlayman.

sentences.text: Kate **will** be at the conference, because her company is paying for the ticket.
sentences.translation: Keyt konferensiyada **bo'ladi**, chunki chiptasini kompaniyasi to'layapti.

sentences.text: Kate **would** come to the conference, but she can't get a day off.
sentences.translation: Keyt konferensiyaga **kelardi**, lekin ishdan javob ololmayapti.

sentences.text: We **won't** have time to visit Samarkand on this trip, because the tour only includes Tashkent and Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bu safar Samarqandga borishga **vaqtimiz bo'lmaydi**, chunki tur faqat Toshkent va Buxoroni o'z ichiga oladi.

sentences.text: We **wouldn't** have enough money for a holiday if we bought a new car.
sentences.translation: Yangi mashina olsak, ta'tilga **pulimiz yetmasdi**.

sentences.text: Is it a good idea? — Yes, a bigger office **will** help us a lot when the new staff arrive.
sentences.translation: Bu yaxshi fikrmi? — Ha, yangi xodimlar kelganda kattaroq ofis bizga ko'p **yordam beradi**.

sentences.text: A bigger office **would** help us, but the rent is far too high.
sentences.translation: Kattaroq ofis bizga **yordam berardi**, lekin ijara haqi juda baland.

sentences.text: What **will** you do after graduation? — I'm going to do a master's in Manchester.
sentences.translation: O'qishni bitirgach nima **qilasiz**? — Manchesterda magistraturada o'qimoqchiman.

sentences.text: What **would** you do if you didn't have to work? — I'd travel round the world.
sentences.translation: Ishlashingiz shart bo'lmaganida nima **qilardingiz**? — Dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardim.

examples.title: **would have done**: it didn't happen
examples.description: would have + V3 — o'tmishda bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin bo'lmadi. Ko'pincha but bilan: sababi aytiladi. O'zbekchada «-gan bo'lardi».

sentences.text: I **would have called** you, but my phone battery was dead.
sentences.translation: Senga **qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lardim**, lekin telefonimning quvvati tugab qolgan edi.

sentences.text: Tom **would have enjoyed** the concert — it's a pity he was ill.
sentences.translation: Tom konsertdan **zavqlangan bo'lardi** — afsuski, u kasal edi.

sentences.text: We **would have stayed** longer in Edinburgh, but our flight home was already booked.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda uzoqroq **qolgan bo'lardik**, lekin uyga qaytish reysimiz allaqachon band qilingan edi.

sentences.text: Madina **would have bought** the dress, but they didn't have it in her size.
sentences.translation: Madina o'sha ko'ylakni **sotib olgan bo'lardi**, lekin uning o'lchami yo'q ekan.

sentences.text: Thanks for the warning — I **would have made** a terrible mistake without your help.
sentences.translation: Ogohlantirganingiz uchun rahmat — yordamingiz bo'lmaganda, dahshatli xatoga **yo'l qo'ygan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: In the old days, the journey from Bukhara to Khiva **would have taken** weeks.
sentences.translation: Qadim zamonlarda Buxorodan Xivagacha bo'lgan yo'l bir necha hafta **davom etgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **have accepted** the job in London? — Probably not; I didn't want to move.
sentences.translation: Londondagi ishni **qabul qilgan bo'larmidingiz**? — Ehtimol, yo'q, ko'chishni xohlamagan edim.

sentences.text: Our team **would have won**, but the referee gave a penalty in the last minute.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz **g'alaba qozongan bo'lardi**, lekin hakam oxirgi daqiqada penalti berdi.

sentences.text: It was so hot that a swim in the lake **would have been** perfect.
sentences.translation: Shunday issiq ediki, ko'lda suzish **ayni muddao bo'lgan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Aziz didn't tell his parents about the accident, as they **would have worried** too much.
sentences.translation: Aziz ota-onasiga avariya haqida aytmadi, chunki ular haddan tashqari **xavotirlangan bo'lardi**.

examples.title: **wouldn't have done** and questions
examples.description: wouldn't have + V3 — bo'lmagan bo'lardi; savol: What would you have done? Ko'pincha otherwise (aks holda) yoki without bilan.

sentences.text: I bought that phone without reading the reviews; otherwise I **wouldn't have bought** it.
sentences.translation: Men o'sha telefonni sharhlarni o'qimasdan oldim, aks holda uni **sotib olmagan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I didn't know it was your seat, or I **wouldn't have sat** here.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu sizning joyingiz ekanini bilmabman, aks holda bu yerga **o'tirmagan bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: Without the GPS, we **wouldn't have found** the hotel in those narrow streets.
sentences.translation: GPS bo'lmaganida, o'sha tor ko'chalarda mehmonxonani **topmagan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: What **would** you **have done** in my situation? — I'd have phoned the police.
sentences.translation: Mening o'rnimda nima **qilgan bo'lardingiz**? — Politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lardim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wouldn't have passed** the exam without her brother's help with maths.
sentences.translation: Akasining matematikadan yordami bo'lmaganida, Dilnoza imtihondan **o'tolmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: **Would** an earlier train **have made** any difference? — No, the meeting started late anyway.
sentences.translation: Ertaroq poyezd biror narsani **o'zgartirgan bo'larmidi**? — Yo'q, yig'ilish baribir kech boshlandi.

sentences.text: My parents **wouldn't have let** me go to the festival alone at sixteen.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam o'n olti yoshimda festivalga yolg'iz **borishimga ruxsat bermagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Who **would have thought** that a small start-up from Fergana could become so successful?
sentences.translation: Farg'onadagi kichik startap shunchalik muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishini kim **o'ylabdi** deysiz?

sentences.text: James is glad he took the job — he **wouldn't have met** his wife otherwise.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'sha ishga kirganidan xursand — aks holda xotini bilan **tanishmagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: A cheaper hotel **would have been** fine, but Kate insisted on the best one in town.
sentences.translation: Arzonroq mehmonxona ham **bo'laverardi**, lekin Keyt shahardagi eng yaxshisini talab qildi.

examples.title: The past of **will**: she said she **would** ...
examples.description: O'tmishdan turib kelajak haqida: said / told / knew / thought / hoped / was sure + would. will → would.

sentences.text: Aziz promised he **would** fix my bike by the weekend.
sentences.translation: Aziz velosipedimni dam olish kunlarigacha **tuzatib berishga** va'da berdi.

sentences.text: The forecast said it **would** rain in the afternoon, so we took our umbrellas.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotida tushdan keyin yomg'ir **yog'ishi** aytilgan edi, shuning uchun soyabonlarimizni oldik.

sentences.text: I knew you **would** like this restaurant — the plov is amazing.
sentences.translation: Bu restoran sizga **yoqishini** bilardim — palovi ajoyib.

sentences.text: Emma told me she **would** be late, because her train was delayed.
sentences.translation: Emma poyezdi kechikkani uchun **kechikib qolishini** aytdi.

sentences.text: At that time nobody imagined that the little shop **would** become a huge company.
sentences.translation: O'shanda hech kim o'sha kichkina do'kon ulkan kompaniyaga **aylanishini** tasavvur qilmagan edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod said he **wouldn't** be able to come to the wedding, but he came after all.
sentences.translation: Bekzod to'yga **kela olmasligini** aytgan edi, lekin baribir keldi.

sentences.text: We hoped the weather **would** improve, but it rained for the whole week.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo **yaxshilanadi** deb umid qilgandik, lekin butun hafta yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: Did you think you **would** pass the exam on your first attempt?
sentences.translation: Imtihondan birinchi urinishda **o'taman** deb o'ylaganmidingiz?

sentences.text: The manager assured us that the new system **would** save us hours every week.
sentences.translation: Menejer bizni yangi tizim har hafta soatlab vaqtimizni **tejashiga** ishontirdi.

sentences.text: When I left Tashkent, I was sure I **would** come back within a year.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan ketayotganimda bir yil ichida **qaytib kelishimga** amin edim.

examples.title: **wouldn't** = refused: the car **wouldn't** start
examples.description: wouldn't — kimdir biror ishni qilishni istamadi, ko'nmadi; narsa esa ishlamadi. O'zbekchada oddiy inkor: «aytmadi», «o't olmadi».

sentences.text: The car **wouldn't** start this morning, so I had to take the bus.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab mashina **o't olmadi**, shuning uchun avtobusda borishga majbur bo'ldim.

sentences.text: I asked Madina what was wrong, but she **wouldn't** tell me.
sentences.translation: Madinadan nima bo'lganini so'radim, lekin u **aytishni istamadi**.

sentences.text: The baby **wouldn't** stop crying until we turned on some quiet music.
sentences.translation: Biz sokin musiqa qo'ymagunimizcha chaqaloq yig'idan **to'xtamadi**.

sentences.text: We tried to explain, but the officer **wouldn't** listen to us.
sentences.translation: Biz tushuntirmoqchi bo'ldik, lekin xodim bizni **tinglashni xohlamadi**.

sentences.text: My laptop **wouldn't** connect to the hotel Wi-Fi, so I worked in the lobby.
sentences.translation: Noutbukim mehmonxona Wi-Fi'iga **ulanmadi**, shuning uchun qabulxonada ishladim.

sentences.text: Even after an hour of arguing, Tom **wouldn't** admit he was wrong.
sentences.translation: Bir soatlik bahsdan keyin ham Tom noto'g'ri ekanini **tan olmadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur's grandmother **wouldn't** take any money for the vegetables from her garden.
sentences.translation: Jasurning buvisi bog'idagi sabzavotlari uchun hech qanday **pul olishni xohlamadi**.

sentences.text: The door **wouldn't** open, no matter how hard we pushed it.
sentences.translation: Qanchalik kuchli itarmaylik, eshik **ochilmadi**.

sentences.text: Why **wouldn't** the bank give you a loan? — My income wasn't high enough.
sentences.translation: Nega bank sizga kredit **bermadi**? — Daromadim yetarlicha yuqori emas edi.

sentences.text: For years Sarah's father **wouldn't** let her travel abroad on her own.
sentences.translation: Yillar davomida Saraning otasi uning chet elga yolg'iz sayohat qilishiga **ruxsat bermasdi**.

examples.title: Past habits: **would** = used to
examples.description: would + fe'l — o'tmishda muntazam takrorlangan harakat (used to ga yaqin). Faqat harakatlar uchun, holatlar uchun emas. O'zbekchada «-ardik».

sentences.text: When I was a child, my grandmother **would** tell me stories every night.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda buvim har kecha menga ertak **aytib berardi**.

sentences.text: Every summer we **would** go to the village and **pick** apricots in the garden.
sentences.translation: Har yozda qishloqqa **borardik** va bog'da o'rik **terardik**.

sentences.text: On Sundays my father **would** make plov for the whole family.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari otam butun oila uchun palov **damlardi**.

sentences.text: In those days people **would** write letters instead of sending messages.
sentences.translation: O'sha kunlarda odamlar xabar yuborish o'rniga xat **yozishardi**.

sentences.text: As students, Oliver and I **would** stay up all night talking about books and politics.
sentences.translation: Talabaligimizda Oliver bilan tun bo'yi kitoblar va siyosat haqida **gaplashib chiqardik**.

sentences.text: Whenever it snowed, the kids **would** build a snowman in front of the school.
sentences.translation: Qor yog'gan har safar bolalar maktab oldida qorbobo **yasashardi**.

sentences.text: My first boss **would** check every email before I sent it, which drove me crazy.
sentences.translation: Birinchi boshlig'im har bir xatimni yuborishimdan oldin **tekshirib chiqardi**, bu meni jinni qilardi.

sentences.text: Before the metro opened, Nilufar **would** spend two hours a day on buses.
sentences.translation: Metro ochilmasdan oldin Nilufar kuniga ikki soatini avtobuslarda **o'tkazardi**.

sentences.text: We **used to** have a dog called Bars — he **would** wait for us at the gate every evening.
sentences.translation: Bizda Bars degan it **bor edi** — u har kuni kechqurun bizni darvoza oldida **kutib turardi**.

sentences.text: Sometimes Grandpa **would** sit in the garden for hours without saying a word.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan bobom bog'da bir og'iz so'z demay soatlab **o'tirardi**.

examples.title: Mixed: imagined, unreal and remembered
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: tasavvur, would have done, will ning o'tmishi, wouldn't (ko'nmadi) va o'tmishdagi odat.

sentences.text: **It would be** a shame to miss the festival, so let's buy the tickets today.
sentences.translation: Festivalni o'tkazib yuborish **achinarli bo'lardi**, shuning uchun chiptalarni bugun olaylik.

sentences.text: I**'d have come** to your presentation, but nobody told me about it.
sentences.translation: Taqdimotingizga **kelgan bo'lardim**, lekin bu haqda hech kim aytmadi.

sentences.text: Even as a small boy, Bekzod **would** take apart every clock in the house.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hatto kichkinaligida ham uydagi har bir soatni **qismlarga ajratib tashlardi**.

sentences.text: The printer **wouldn't** work, so Kate had to send the report as a PDF.
sentences.translation: Printer **ishlamadi**, shuning uchun Keyt hisobotni PDF qilib yuborishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Most people **wouldn't** pay that much for a coffee, but this café is always full.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik bitta qahva uchun shuncha pul **to'lamasdi**, lekin bu kafe doim to'la.

sentences.text: You said you **would** send the documents yesterday — where are they?
sentences.translation: Kecha hujjatlarni **yuborishingizni** aytgan edingiz — ular qani?

sentences.text: What **would** your life be like without your phone for a week?
sentences.translation: Bir hafta telefonsiz hayotingiz qanday **bo'lardi**?

sentences.text: Honestly, the old manager **would never have allowed** such long breaks.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, eski menejer bunday uzun tanaffuslarga hech qachon **ruxsat bermagan bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Every time we visited, our aunt **would** cook far too much food.
sentences.translation: Har safar borganimizda xolamiz juda ko'p ovqat **pishirardi**.

sentences.text: James thought the flight **would** be long and boring, but he slept the whole way.
sentences.translation: Jeyms parvoz uzoq va zerikarli **bo'ladi** deb o'ylagan edi, lekin butun yo'l uxlab ketdi.
